'''Richie Destroy The Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] deck by Richie, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds85.htm Destroy The Jedi], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002836/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds85.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' Richie
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
